title: cryptocarpha lanata
intro: Cryptocarpha lanata, commonly known as the 'Woolly Needle Fern', is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in various studies. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential of Cryptocarpha lanata and its safety for human consumption.
